description: Foundation data model with no behavior change yet: the admin-clients config section in internal/config, the SPKI fingerprint column/methods in internal/registry, and the two hand-added gRPC RPCs (RestoreToTarget, ControlClientWatcher) in the hand-maintained proto. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (authorization consumes the config helpers, the registry SPKI map, and the new RPCs). It leaves the tree building green with the new types present but not yet enforced. Grounded in design.md sections 1.4, 2, 5.2, 5.5.
steps: internal/config/config.go: add `Admin AdminConfig `toml:"admin"`` to Config; define `type AdminConfig struct { Clients []AdminClient `toml:"clients"` }` and `type AdminClient struct { Name string `toml:"name"`; Fingerprint string `toml:"fingerprint"` }` (design §2). applyDefaults sets nothing for Admin so a config without [admin] decodes to an empty slice.

internal/config/config.go: extend Config.Validate — for each admin client, require fingerprint to match `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` and be unique across the list; append aggregated model.ConfigError messages in the existing style (e.g. `admin.clients[i].fingerprint must be 64 hex characters`).

internal/config/config.go: add helpers `func (c *Config) IsAdminFingerprint(fp string) bool` (linear scan over already-canonical stored values), `func (c *Config) AddAdminClient(name, fp string) error` (strings.TrimSpace then strings.ToLower on fp, validate `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`, dedup by fingerprint — return status/no-op if present, else append; return model.ConfigError on bad value), `func (c *Config) RemoveAdminClientByName(name string) bool`, `func (c *Config) RemoveAdminClientByFingerprint(fp string) bool` (normalize fp before comparing).

internal/config/config_test.go: add tests — load TOML without [admin] -> empty list (backward compat); round-trip Save/Load with entries; Validate rejects bad hex, duplicate fingerprint, empty fingerprint; AddAdminClient dedups and normalizes a pasted UPPERCASE/space-padded fingerprint to canonical lowercase; RemoveAdminClientByName/ByFingerprint; IsAdminFingerprint true/false.

internal/registry/registry.go: add `SPKIFingerprint string` field to ClientInfo; append `ALTER TABLE client_registry ADD COLUMN spki_fingerprint TEXT DEFAULT ''` to the existing idempotent migration block in createTables (next to disabled/os_family/machine_id/hostname).

internal/registry/registry.go: extend loadClients SELECT + Scan, persistClientLocked INSERT column list, and the ON CONFLICT(client_id) DO UPDATE SET block to carry spki_fingerprint with the guard `spki_fingerprint = CASE WHEN excluded.spki_fingerprint != '' THEN excluded.spki_fingerprint ELSE client_registry.spki_fingerprint END` (mirroring os_family).

internal/registry/registry.go: add `func (r *Registry) SetSPKIFingerprint(clientID, fp string) error` (r.mu.Lock, update in-memory clients[clientID].SPKIFingerprint, call persistClientLocked; no-op if the row is absent) and `func (r *Registry) FindClientBySPKI(fp string) *ClientInfo` (RLock linear scan; on match return a COPY `cp := *ci; return &cp` per the copy-on-read convention used by GetClient/ListClients).

internal/registry/registry_test.go: add tests — migration adds the column on a legacy DB (open a DB with the old schema, construct registry, assert no error and column present); SetSPKIFingerprint then FindClientBySPKI round-trips; an empty fp passed through the upsert never erases a previously stored fingerprint.

internal/grpc/proto/command.go: add hand-written structs `RestoreToTargetRequest` (SourceClientId, TargetClientId, Query, BackupId, File, Dest), `RestoreToTargetResponse` (Success, FilesSent, FilesReceived, FilesFailed, Message), and `ControlWatcherRequest` (TargetClientId, Start) with `json:` tags in the exact style of the existing RebindClientRequest; reuse the existing WatcherResponse for ControlClientWatcher.

internal/grpc/proto/command_grpc.go: add both unary RPCs RestoreToTarget and ControlClientWatcher following the RebindClient template — add to the CommandServiceClient interface + client stub methods, add the two `CommandService_*_FullMethodName` consts, add to the CommandServiceServer interface, add UnimplementedCommandServiceServer stub methods (return codes.Unimplemented), add the `_CommandService_RestoreToTarget_Handler`/`_CommandService_ControlClientWatcher_Handler` functions, and add both entries to the CommandService_ServiceDesc.Methods table (both unary -> Methods, not Streams).

proto/v3/command.proto: reconcile to the real generated surface — add the currently-undocumented RPCs/messages (StartWatcher, StopWatcher, RegisterClient, ListRecoverableClients, RebindClient, PushRestore, CommandTunnel) AND the two new RPCs (RestoreToTarget, ControlClientWatcher) with their request/response messages, so the .proto documents what the generated code exposes. This is documentation-only; do NOT run protoc or buf.
acceptance_criteria: `go test ./internal/config/...` passes including the new backward-compat, round-trip, validation, and helper tests.
`go test ./internal/registry/...` passes including the migration, Set/Find round-trip, and empty-value-preservation tests.
`go build ./...` compiles with the two new RPCs present in the generated proto and the ServiceDesc.
`go test ./internal/grpc/...` passes — the existing mTLS integration tests still succeed, proving the hand-edited ServiceDesc is well-formed.
A tergum.toml without an [admin] section still loads without error (no regression).
findings:
Implemented and committed on feature/admin-clients. Surface for downstream features (FEAT-002+):

CONFIG (internal/config/config.go, package config):
- Config now has field `Admin AdminConfig `toml:"admin"``.
- `type AdminConfig struct { Clients []AdminClient `toml:"clients"` }`.
- `type AdminClient struct { Name string `toml:"name"`; Fingerprint string `toml:"fingerprint"` }`.
- Canonical fingerprint = 64 lowercase hex chars; validated by package var `adminFingerprintRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{64}$`)`. Config.Validate aggregates `admin.clients[i].fingerprint must be 64 hex characters` and a duplicate-fingerprint message into the existing `model.ConfigError`.
- Helpers (value receiver *Config): `IsAdminFingerprint(fp string) bool` (expects already-canonical fp, plain linear scan — callers must normalize before calling); `AddAdminClient(name, fp string) error` (TrimSpace+ToLower fp, validates regex, dedups by fingerprint returning nil no-op if present, returns *model.ConfigError on bad value); `RemoveAdminClientByName(name string) bool`; `RemoveAdminClientByFingerprint(fp string) bool` (normalizes fp before compare). A config with no [admin] section decodes to an empty slice and validates clean.

REGISTRY (internal/registry/registry.go, package registry):
- `ClientInfo` has new field `SPKIFingerprint string` (SHA-256 of client mTLS leaf cert RawSubjectPublicKeyInfo / SPKI, lowercase hex).
- Idempotent migration adds column `spki_fingerprint TEXT DEFAULT ''`; loadClients SELECT/Scan and persistClientLocked INSERT carry it; upsert guard `spki_fingerprint = CASE WHEN excluded.spki_fingerprint != '' THEN excluded.spki_fingerprint ELSE client_registry.spki_fingerprint END` (empty never erases).
- Methods: `(*Registry) SetSPKIFingerprint(clientID, fp string) error` (locks, updates in-memory + persists; no-op/nil if clientID absent); `(*Registry) FindClientBySPKI(fp string) *ClientInfo` (RLock linear scan, returns a COPY per copy-on-read; empty fp returns nil).

GRPC PROTO (hand-maintained — do NOT run protoc/buf):
- internal/grpc/proto/command.go new structs: `RestoreToTargetRequest{SourceClientId, TargetClientId, Query, BackupId, File, Dest string}`; `RestoreToTargetResponse{Success bool; FilesSent, FilesReceived, FilesFailed int64; Message string}`; `ControlWatcherRequest{TargetClientId string; Start bool}`. ControlClientWatcher REUSES existing `WatcherResponse{Success bool; Message string}`.
- internal/grpc/proto/command_grpc.go two new UNARY RPCs on CommandService: `RestoreToTarget(ctx, *RestoreToTargetRequest) (*RestoreToTargetResponse, error)` and `ControlClientWatcher(ctx, *ControlWatcherRequest) (*WatcherResponse, error)`. Added to CommandServiceClient + client stub, CommandServiceServer interface, UnimplementedCommandServiceServer stubs (codes.Unimplemented), FullMethodName consts `CommandService_RestoreToTarget_FullMethodName` and `CommandService_ControlClientWatcher_FullMethodName`, _Handler funcs, and both entries in CommandService_ServiceDesc.Methods (unary). Existing impls (CommandServer, ClientCommandServer) embed UnimplementedCommandServiceServer so they still satisfy the interface; FEAT-002 overrides RestoreToTarget/ControlClientWatcher on CommandServer and enforces authorization via a callerIsAdmin predicate over Config.IsAdminFingerprint.
- proto/v3/command.proto reconciled (documentation-only) to the full generated surface incl. the two new RPCs/messages and a note that the Go is hand-maintained.

VERIFICATION: `go build ./...`, `go test ./internal/config/... ./internal/registry/... ./internal/grpc/...`, and `make lint` all pass. NOTE: `internal/retention` tests (TestEvaluate_ProtectsLatestVersion, TestEvaluate_DryRunDoesNotModifyDB, TestEvaluate_PhysicalFileDeletedOnlyWhenRefcountZero) fail — these are PRE-EXISTING failures on the untouched main worktree and are unrelated to FEAT-001 (which does not touch internal/retention).
